question: Show products purchased by each customer.
generated_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.name AS customer_name, p.name AS product_name FROM public.customers AS c INNER JOIN public.orders AS o ON c.id = o.customer_id INNER JOIN public.order_items AS oi ON o.id = oi.order_id INNER JOIN public.products AS p ON oi.product_id = p.id LIMIT 1000
